notes: Managed private SearXNG. A.C.E. now owns its own pinned SearXNG runtime with no Docker, Terminal setup or separately launched search app. On the first launch after this update, A.C.E. quietly prepares a private SearXNG environment in its Application Support folder, then starts and health-checks it automatically on 127.0.0.1:8888 for future research. Normal research uses this localhost service first; public SearXNG is emergency fallback only. Existing source recall, forest/lime theme, voice, controls and artifact behavior remain intact.
